newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-BANKS GAIN FURTHER, HANSA LEADS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-BANKS GAIN FURTHER, HANSA LEADS.

text.p: Banking shares rose sharply on
on Friday although further technical problems stopped the
market, dealers said.
Dealers said the bourse was open between 1015 to 1100 but
complained that the bourse authorities had made no annoucement
as to whether trade had opened again at all.
The bourse stopped trade at 1122 on Thursday because its
computer network ran into technical problems.
Amid the glitches, Hansapank rose to 191.60/195 kroons from
189.75 kroons and Hoiupank gained to 200/204 kroons from 199.80.
Uhispank , Tallinna Pank and Forekspank
were also up by several kroons.
"This is called general optimism," one dealer said.
Traders said no sellers were being seen at current prices as
investors did not want to lose their positions ahead of expected
higher profit forecasts.
On the free market, Norma was the most active on trade of
2.8 mln kroons and traded lower at 87.50/89.50 kroons from 88
kroons.
-- Eva Palu, Tallinn newsroom, +372 6209 201,
reuters@reuters.ee
